index.html.title: Firmware reference · AuroraSwitch
index.html.body:
AuroraSwitch

Choose a supported firmware from a USB drive and launch it on your Aurora.

Beta software: keep the original Aurora firmware for recovery.

Quick start

Back up a FAT USB drive. No repository checkout or build tools are needed.

  1. Download AuroraSwitch.bin
    to the drive's root. Keep it as the only BIN there.
  2. Create an aurora/ folder. Add Aurora 1.4.4
    (unzip first), FDN 1.2.2, or both.
  3. Safely eject, insert the drive into Aurora, and power cycle to install.

Select firmware

  1. Reverse selects by color.
  2. Freeze loads and verifies; wait for green.
  3. Shift launches.

Power cycle to return to the selector.

Other supported firmware BINs go in the same aurora/ folder. Files shared on
Discord must be added manually. See the user guide.

fdn-122.html.title: FDN 1.2.2 · AuroraSwitch
fdn-122.html.body:
FDN 1.2.2

Blue

Download BIN. Save in aurora/.

Stereo feedback-delay-network reverb. Start with moderate Time; high settings feed back.

Knobs and CV

Panel knob / matching CV Function
1 Warp Pitch: modulation amount; CCW disables modulation
2 Time Decay; short/comb-like CCW, near-infinite CW
3 Blur Input Level: 25–150% by default
4 Reflect Highpass: wet-signal high-pass filtering, increasing CW
5 Mix Dry/wet balance
6 Atmosphere Damp: damping increases CW

Buttons and gates

Button Function
7 Reverse Reverse incoming audio
8 Freeze Hold captured audio
97 Shift + Reverse Swap DSP order: reverb last ↔ reverse last
98 Shift + Freeze Switch input-level range: 25–150% ↔ 0–150%

Details & sources

  • CV: ±5 V; Reverse/Freeze gate threshold: 0.4 V.
  • Left input feeds both channels without a right input cable.
  • Running LEDs: purple/gold.

Source: Qu-Bit's FDN getting started guide.

aurora-144.html.title: Aurora 1.4.4 · AuroraSwitch
aurora-144.html.body:
Aurora 1.4.4

Green

Download ZIP. Extract Aurora_v1_4_4.bin into aurora/.

Stock spectral reverb: pitch manipulation, spectral smearing and stereo delays.

Knobs and CV

Panel knob / matching CV Function
1 Warp Pitch shift ±3 octaves; noon is unshifted; CV tracks 1 V/oct
2 Time Amplitude-domain smearing / spectral tail
3 Blur Frequency-domain smearing
4 Reflect Increasing multi-delay time zones, from no extra delay CCW
5 Mix Dry ↔ wet
6 Atmosphere Spectral/time filtering: underwater below noon, brighter then high-pass above noon

Buttons and shifted controls

Button / shifted control Function
7 Reverse Reverse audio; active LED green; state retained
8 Freeze Sustain the current spectrum; Warp/Time/Blur/Atmosphere/Mix still work
95 Shift + Mix Input gain, 0.5–4×; blue indicates default 1×
94 Shift + Reflect Stereo enhancement, 0–100%; blue indicates default 75%
97 Shift + Reverse Cycle FFT size: 4096 blue → 2048 green → 1024 cyan → 512 purple
97 Shift + Reverse, held 2 seconds Factory reset UI/options defaults; white confirmation animation
98 Shift + Freeze Reload USB settings; successful reload flashes white

Changing FFT size clears the frozen spectrum. Larger FFTs give smoother tails but more latency.

Details & sources

  • Warp LEDs: green/blue on octave; green/purple off octave.
  • CV: ±5 V; gate threshold: 0.4 V.
  • Keep settings files. Reloading settings does not update firmware.

USB options.txt defaults:

Setting Default Controls
DSP_ORDER 1 DSP order
FREEZE_WET 0 Freeze forces full-wet
LATENCY_COMP 0 Dry latency compensation
ALWAYS_BLUR 1 Always-on blur
QUANTIZE_WARP 1 Warp quantization; 2 = knob + CV
WARP_DEADZONES 1 Octave deadzones

Source: Aurora manual v1.7.4,
covering firmware 1.4.4. Calibration is maintenance, not a performance control.

echogarden-031.html.title: EchoGarden 0.3.1 · AuroraSwitch
echogarden-031.html.body:
EchoGarden 0.3.1

Cyan

Get firmware on Qu-Bit's Discord (login required).
Find AuroraEchoGarden_v0_3_1_STABLE.bin and save it in aurora/. No stable public download URL is available.

Multi-line echoes with diffusion/reverb around the repeats.

Knobs

Panel knob Function
1 Warp Echo spacing: tight → roughly 1× / 1.33× / 1.67× / 2×
2 Time Base echo time, about 15 ms–1.8 s
3 Blur Reverb/diffusion depth
4 Reflect Feedback, up to about 96% normally
5 Mix Dry/wet
6 Atmosphere Select 1–4 active echo lines

Buttons and gates

Control Function / active LED
8 Freeze Latch held feedback; removes new input / yellow
7 Reverse Latch ping-pong/cross-feedback / green
9 Shift, held Bloom: more reverb and a longer tail
78 Reverse / Freeze gates Temporarily invert stored button states

Details & sources

  • Knob meter: Time/Blur blue, Reflect red, Mix/Warp yellow, Atmosphere green.
  • Starting point: Time 40%, Reflect 50%, Mix 60%, one line, Blur 10%, Warp low.
  • CV scaling/ranges: not specified.

Source: author-supplied EchoGarden v0.3.1 Parameter Manual.

cloudscapex.html.title: CloudscapeX · AuroraSwitch
cloudscapex.html.body:
CloudscapeX

Magenta

Get firmware on Qu-Bit's Discord (login required).
Find AuroraCloudscapeX.bin and save it in aurora/. No stable public download URL is available.

Modulated delay, diffusion and filter delay.

Knobs

Panel knob Normal / Filter Delay mode
1 Warp Timing spread and modulation / resonance plus cutoff motion
2 Time Delay about 10 ms–1.05 s / about 18–780 ms
3 Blur Diffusion/reverb / filter cutoff about 85 Hz–18 kHz
4 Reflect Network feedback / delay feedback
5 Mix Dry/wet
6 Atmosphere 1–4 lines / LP → BP → HP → notch filter selection

Buttons and gates

Button Latched effect / active LED
8 Freeze Hold cloud / white
7 Reverse Rotate or ping-pong routing / cyan
98 Shift + Freeze Lush Reverb / blue
97 Shift + Reverse Filter Delay / yellow
78 Reverse / Freeze gates Temporarily invert stored button states

All four effects latch independently.

Details & sources

  • Combined LEDs alternate: Freeze white/blue (Hold + Lush); Reverse cyan/yellow (Rotate + Filter Delay).
  • Parameter LEDs: Time blue, Reflect red, Mix yellow, Atmosphere green, Blur cyan, Warp magenta.
  • Starting point: Time 30%, Reflect 40%, Mix 55%, Atmosphere 50%, Blur 30%, Warp 25%.
  • CV scaling/ranges: not specified.

Source: author-supplied Cloudscape v1.6 One Page Parameter Manual;
identified as the only release paired with CloudscapeX.bin.

the-oscillator-is-a-lie-002.html.title: The Oscillator Is a Lie 0.0.2 · AuroraSwitch
the-oscillator-is-a-lie-002.html.body:
The Oscillator Is a Lie 0.0.2

Amber

Get firmware on Qu-Bit's Discord (login required).
Find TheOscillatorIsALie_v0_0_2.bin and save it in aurora/. No stable public download URL is available.

Aliasing/ring-mod oscillator, not a reverb. Raise Blur above zero to hear it.

Knobs

Panel knob Function
1 Warp Pitch offset; latest supplied note says ±2 octaves; CV is V/oct
2 Time Carrier-to-target ratio, 1–8×
3 Blur Output level without clipping; clipping drive when enabled
4 Reflect Low-pass resonance
5 Mix CW: main output; CCW: blend raw modulator left / raw carrier right
6 Atmosphere Low-pass cutoff; minimum tracks target pitch, maximum about 10 kHz

Buttons and gates

Button Function / LED
7 Reverse Carrier waveform: sine blue → triangle magenta → saw yellow → square cyan
8 Freeze Aliasing green ↔ ring-modulation blue
97 Shift + Reverse Clipping: off → before filter white → after filter red
98 Shift + Freeze Mix routing: normal off → main-only left white → main-only right red
78 Reverse / Freeze gates Waveform / mode, per later author notes

Details & sources

  • Top LEDs: pitch/ratio consonance. Lower LEDs: cutoff, resonance and gain.
  • Other CV mappings and audio-input use: undocumented.
  • Later notes change Warp from ±1 to ±2 octaves and add level control;
    their pairing with the 0.0.2 BIN has not been independently verified.

Source: supplied author notes, February 10–11, 2026.

flux-capacitor.html.title: Flux Capacitor · AuroraSwitch
flux-capacitor.html.body:
Flux Capacitor

Yellow0.3.0 · 0.1.0 (development) · 0.2.0 (development)

Download BIN: 0.3.0,
0.2.0,
0.1.0.
Save one version in aurora/; older versions need the source-build selector.

Stereo tape-style pitch, braking, delay and coloration.

Knobs and CV

Panel knob / CV Function
1 Warp Smooth pitch ±12 semitones; CV 1 V/oct
2 Time Delay 1 ms–2 s in 0.2/0.3; unused in 0.1
3 Blur Flutter depth
4 Reflect Wow rate, 0.1–2 Hz
5 Mix Dry/wet
6 Atmosphere Tone darkening, saturation and feedback in 0.3; unused in 0.1/0.2

Buttons and gates

Control Function
8 Freeze Tape stop/start over roughly 1.5 seconds
8 Freeze gate Force stop while high
79 Reverse / Reverse gate / Shift Unused

A stopped wet signal is silent. Fully dry Mix temporarily becomes wet during braking/startup.

Version differences

Version Difference
0.1.0 Pitch, braking, wow/flutter only
0.2.0 Adds delay with fixed feedback
0.3.0 Adds Atmosphere coloration/feedback

Details & sources

  • Active CVs add to knobs and clamp.
  • Arc LEDs: amber = pitch up, cyan = down. Freeze: red braking, white dry-Mix boundary flashes.

Sources: 0.3.0 guide
and versioned main.cpp / tape_delay.h at tags 0.1.0 and 0.2.0.

morse.html.title: Morse · AuroraSwitch
morse.html.body:
Morse

White0.2.0 · 0.1.0 (development)

Download BIN: 0.2.0,
0.1.0.
Save one version in aurora/; 0.1.0 needs the source-build selector.

Clocked stereo VCA: audio input + clock into Freeze gate + Mix above zero.
Freeze button alone does not clock it.

Knobs and buttons

Panel control Function
2 Time + CV Pattern selection
5 Mix Output level
3 Blur Envelope attack/decay balance in 0.2; unused in 0.1
146 Warp, Reflect, Atmosphere Unused
7 Reverse button / gate Reset pattern
8 Freeze gate Clock input
98 Shift + Freeze Cycle clock ratio: /8 → /4 → /2 → ×1 → ×2 → ×4 → ×8

Version differences

Version Difference
0.1.0 Three patterns: dotted-8th, slow pulse, triplet; instant attack + decay
0.2.0 Twelve patterns; Blur controls attack/decay

Pattern changes apply at a step boundary or reset, not only the next Reset.

Details & sources

  • Other knob CVs: unused.
  • With Shift held, Freeze shows ratio: violet /8, blue /4, light blue /2,
    white ×1, yellow ×2, orange ×4, red ×8.
  • Freeze flashes on ticks; Reverse on reset. Arc LEDs show pattern step/envelope.

Sources: 0.2.0 guide
and main.cpp, pattern.h, envelope.h at tags 0.1.0/0.2.0.

tempest-100.html.title: Tempest 1.0.0 · AuroraSwitch
tempest-100.html.body:
Tempest 1.0.0

Pale red

Download BIN.
Save in aurora/; requires the source-build selector.

Stereo distortion with a clean low-frequency bypass. Mix is not dry/wet.

Knobs and CV

Panel knob / CV Function
1 Warp Drive, 1–100×
2 Time Pre-distortion high-pass, 20 Hz–2 kHz
3 Blur Algorithm variation
4 Reflect Bipolar bias; center deadzone; reduced range in Standard mode
5 Mix Crossover, 20–500 Hz
6 Atmosphere Post-distortion low-pass, 20 Hz–20 kHz
95 Shift + Mix Output trim, 0–2×

Buttons and gates

Control Function
7 Reverse Next algorithm
8 Freeze Previous algorithm
97 Shift + Reverse Next bank
98 Shift + Freeze Standard green → tube orange → odd/inharmonic purple
89 Freeze, hold 5 seconds without Shift Toggle cabinet simulation; three white blinks
8 Freeze gate Hold an input sample
7 Reverse gate Octave-up rectification

Details & sources

  • CVs add to knobs (±5 V).
  • Reverse LED: bank; Freeze: mode; arc: algorithm/distortion level.
  • Settings autosave after two seconds without changes.
Bank / running color Algorithms, in order
Analog / Orange SftClp, HardClp, StrgrC, Valve, Antipol, Disto
Fold / Purple WavFld, Crest, Sstrgi, Fezz, Fuss, Cross
Geometric / Yellow VariWS, SmartE, Vshpe, Square, Cubic, Anti+
LoFi / Cyan Bitcrsh, DwnSpl, Lowfi, Lowrfi, ChastB, SuspB
Chaos / Red Fractl, Zippy, Bounce, NoizE, BrwnNz, Attrac
Temporal / Green Filter, TimeFr, Vinyl, Clicks, Jelly, Accum

Sources: version-pinned controls
and algorithm details.

fatamorgana-ram-experiment.html.title: FataMorgana RAM experiment · AuroraSwitch
fatamorgana-ram-experiment.html.body:
FataMorgana RAM experiment

Azure

No compatible prebuilt download. Use the RAM-build instructions
and save the resulting FataMorgana.bin in aurora/. The upstream QSPI build is not interchangeable.

Dual wavetable synth: A left, B right. External audio can modulate or be waveshaped.
Only the exact development RAM build is supported, not upstream QSPI.

Knobs and CV

Panel control Normal / hold Shift
1 Warp + CV Pitch, V/oct (0 V = C0) / B offset ±24 semitones
2 Time + CV X wave position / sub A level
4 Reflect + CV Y wave position / sub B level
6 Atmosphere + CV Z wave position / no separate shifted function documented
3 Blur + CV Effect depth / choose FM, ring mod, bitcrush, wavefold, overdrive
5 Mix knob Unison detune 0–5% / output trim
5 Mix CV VCA: 0 V unity, negative attenuates, positive boosts

Buttons and gates

Control Function / LED
8 Freeze Smooth green ↔ glitchy red morphing
7 Reverse Select A orange → B cyan → both purple
7 Reverse, hold 5 seconds Copy A's wave positions to B
98 Shift + Freeze Toggle external waveshaping
97 Shift + Reverse Toggle clean/degraded tone
7 Reverse gate Randomize both XYZ positions
8 Freeze gate Reserved

Knobs use pickup after oscillator selection: move to the stored position. Warp also after Shift.
Tempest/Fata share a settings sector: switching can change retained settings.

Details & sources

  • Effect LEDs: FM green, ring mod yellow, bitcrush red, wavefold magenta, overdrive orange.
  • Arc pairs: X red, Y green, Z blue; shifted LEDs: subs/effect/trim.
  • USB tables: root 1.wav–8.wav, mono 16-bit PCM, 64 × 256 samples (16,384 total).
  • Without tables, a generated cube is used. USB table loading remains unverified for this RAM build.
Table-loading LED Meaning
Yellow Busy
Green Success
Red Missing
Orange Invalid WAV
Magenta Compressed
Blue Stereo
White Wrong depth
Cyan Too short

Source: pinned FataMorgana guide
and src/FataMorgana.cpp at the same commit.

dirt-verb-11.html.title: Dirt Verb 1.1 · AuroraSwitch
dirt-verb-11.html.body:
Dirt Verb 1.1

Red-pink

Get firmware on Qu-Bit's Discord (login required).
Find DirtVerb 1.1.bin and save it in aurora/; requires the QSPI development selector.
No stable public download URL is available.

Driven reverb with optional chorus and pitch shifting. Only the exact
DirtVerb 1.1.bin is admitted by this branch's selector.

Knobs

Panel knob Function
1 Warp Decay / feedback
2 Time Overdrive
3 Blur Damping
4 Reflect Chorus rate
5 Mix Dry/wet balance
6 Atmosphere Pitch-shifter mix

Buttons

Button Function
7 Reverse Toggle chorus
8 Freeze Toggle pitch shifting

Details & sources

  • Running LEDs: gold at infinite feedback; white when overdrive is bypassed;
    red increases with drive. These are not selector menu colors.
  • Shift, CV and gate behavior is not documented in the supplied author notes.
  • Launch programs application QSPI. Menu re-entry requires ready USB media
    containing AuroraSwitch as the only root BIN; reset alone is not a recovery guarantee.
  • Controls come from community-supplied author notes, not a reviewed source build.
    Physical handoff and stock USB recovery remain unverified.

aurora-hp-filter-variant.html.title: Aurora HP-filter variant · AuroraSwitch
aurora-hp-filter-variant.html.body:
Aurora HP-filter variant

Lime

Get firmware on Qu-Bit's Discord (login required).
Find Aurora_v1-4-6_hpfilt.bin and save it in aurora/; requires the QSPI development selector.
No stable public download URL is available.

Stock Aurora controls with two shifted changes. Place the exact supplied
Aurora_v1-4-6_hpfilt.bin in aurora/; only this development branch's selector
has enough reviewed staging capacity for this image.

Shifted controls

Control Function
96 Shift + Atmosphere Dry-input high-pass
93 Shift + Blur Wet level

Other controls follow the stock Aurora reference.

Details & sources

  • RAM launch; no selector QSPI programming for this payload.
  • Changes are described in the supplied community notes. Physical behavior
    remains unverified; this is not an official Aurora release.
